events.title: Update Notes: Enchants, Cultivation Levels and the New-Player Experience
events.summary: Thank you to everyone who played and sent feedback. These notes cover everything added since August. Cultivation levels When a run ends (cleared, failed or abandoned), your total score for that run is converted into experience towards a permanent Cultivation level. Higher realms give more experience: Mortal ×1.0 Beginning ×1.15 Minor ×1.30 Major ×1.45 Abyss ×1.60 The level cap is 40.
